name: mirza-marketplace
description: Mirza's custom Claude Code plugins. Fork of selected plugins from claude-plugins-official with personal modifications.

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: Custom Telegram channel for Claude Code with a /hello command. Forked from the official Telegram plugin.

plugins.name: immediate-reply
plugins.description: Behavioral skill that makes Claude feel fast on Telegram by sending an instant acknowledgement before any non-trivial work.

plugins.name: interactive-prompts
plugins.description: Behavioral skill that teaches Claude to render inline-keyboard buttons on Telegram for choice prompts (confirmation, single-select) so the user can answer with one tap. Requires telegram >= 0.0.9-mirza.0.
